description: This PHP file defines a model class 'HolidayModel' used in the 'Leave' API of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It represents holiday data with serialization and normalization features, including properties like id, name, date, recurring, length, and lengthName, and is constructed with an instance of the Holiday entity.

classes.name: HolidayModel
classes.description: A data model class representing holiday information in the Leave API, with serialization, filtering, and attribute mapping capabilities.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the HolidayModel with a Holiday entity, setting entity, filters, and attribute names for serialization.
